_comment: Sample MINIMAL Enrollment Status Page (ESP) — reference for INTBASE - ESP - Pilot. Configure in Intune: Devices > Enrollment > Windows > Enrollment Status Page. Keep the pilot ESP light (do not require heavy apps). Field names mirror the Graph windows10EnrollmentCompletionPageConfiguration resource.
description: Minimal Enrollment Status Page for the first-time Windows Autopilot pilot.
customErrorMessage: Setup is taking longer than expected. You can keep using the device; contact IT if this persists.

_notes.scope: Pilot only. Deep ESP tuning (blocking apps, quality updates, per-app tracking) is OUT OF SCOPE — see the deeper Autopilot catalog solutions.
_notes.requiredApps: Leave selectedMobileAppIds empty for the pilot to avoid a blocked ESP.
